en: A colorized historic postcard view of a riverside town with a large castle complex and cathedral on a hill above the river. In the foreground are barges and a steam-powered boat on the river, a quay with people walking, and red‑roofed houses along the bank. On the hill stand a tall round tower, an extensive palace-like building with many gables, and a Gothic church with twin spires. The sky is clear blue and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the names of the castle and cathedral, with an added handwritten number in red ink on the right.
